mostWorthwhile.text: The cold-response sequence was most worthwhile: the matched vessel closeups distinguish reduced heat loss from heat generated by shivering, and the muscle inset connects that production to ATP use.

leastWorthwhile.text: Setting up the warm and cold conditions was predictable, though it made the change in circumstances easy to follow.

surprise.text: The cooling picture showed the sweat-driving signal fading as core temperature approached its earlier range, making feedback visible rather than just showing heat leaving.

arbitrary.text: No action felt particularly arbitrary; each linked the temperature change to sensing, circulation, sweating or muscle activity.

continue.text: I would choose to continue: comparing the warm and cold responses made the constructions useful, and the planned insets connected control signals to their effects without requiring specialist terminology.
